verdicts.explanation: The raw HTML of /contact-sales carries zero extractable words and relies on the __NEXT_DATA__ payload to render, so a non-rendering fetcher truly gets nothing from this page.
The missing phone/email on /contact-sales is a symptom of the whole page being an empty HTML shell, already reported and confirmed as B4_empty_shell on the same URL.
The missing page title on /contact-sales is a symptom of the whole page being an empty HTML shell, already reported and confirmed as B4_empty_shell on the same URL.
The homepage carries no JSON-LD types at all, so there is no Organization block and nothing for a sameAs link to hang off, unlike the template pages which do carry structured data.
The /product/ai page carries no JSON-LD types at all, confirming it has no Product markup even though the page frames itself around a paid product tier.
The affected page is the genuine, content-bearing /product/ai page rather than a placeholder or wrong page, so the unnamed-control count the script measured was taken on a real page that matters.
